ways.label: Monument Hut to Richardson Rock Biv, via Elcho, Cullers, Dodger and Erceg huts
evidence: There is an unmarked route from Huxley gorge via Elcho hut to Cullers and Dodger and on to Erceg and Richardson Rock bivvy at the head of the valley.
The most direct route to Elcho Hut on foot is to stay on the true right of Hopkins valley.
Cross Elcho Stream and look for the hut in the bush margin.
Cross Apricot flat and ford the Hopkins River.
The track across Dodger fan begins on the true left at the confluence of Dodger stream.
From Erceg Hut stay on the true left to reach the rock biv.

doubts: Network page: the main way is the first heading (Ram Hill carpark to Monument Hut). Each later way is a group heading that gives its start and end. The start of the mountain-bike way is not stated, so it is null. The Richardson route heading starts at Monument Hut, but the text sentence says the unmarked route runs from Huxley gorge; the heading is used for the start. Richardson Rock Biv and Dasler Biv Track have no entries in the packet, so their refs are null. Monument Hut to Red Hut and the Hopkins and Huxley crossings are recorded as ford because the text says to cross them and names no bridge; the Huxley gorge swing bridge is mentioned only as a high-water egress track. The Dasler and Richardson ways' individual legs (with their own times) are not made into ways; their times are not summed, so way times are null. DOC's summary is contradictory ('one way' time, 'return via same track' distance), so no way is shaped out_and_back. Red Hut, Dasler Biv, Elcho, Cullers, Dodger, Erceg and Richardson Rock huts are on the other ways, so they are in those ways' via lists; the huts field lists only the main way's huts. The bikers' extension to Red Hut or Elcho Hut (needs river and backcountry skills) is not a separate way.
